_doc: Corrections to the feed's DERIVED result fields (winner_team_id, sets_won), entered only when an attributable public source AND the feed's own primary set-by-set record agree against them. Raw history is never rewritten: the correction applies at the derived-dataset layer, the game carries result_corrected, and the Result Ledger shows the evidence. Append-only. The linescores are the primary record and the winner/sets_won columns are the feed's derivations -- raw counts over derived rates is this project's standing schema decision, and this ledger exists for the day the two disagree.

6627523.established: Southern California (away) beat Arizona St. 3-0 (25-23, 25-21, 25-22) at the Sanford Pentagon, Sioux Falls -- State Farm Women's Volleyball Showcase. The official NCAA LiveStats box score (supplied by Cody as a PDF) shows sets to 25, attendance 3,376, and team records moving (USC 1-0, ASU 2-1): a counting match. The per-set line is supplied from the box score because the feed's own linescores array is EMPTY on this final; a correction may fill an absent line from cited official evidence but may never overwrite one the feed carries.

6626259.feed_said: UC Davis (home) won 3-2 with the set line 27-25, 25-20, 20-25, 23-25, 15-12 attributed to UC Davis -- the TRUE sequence with the TEAMS SWAPPED. Internally coherent, and wrong.
6626259.established: SMU (away) beat UC Davis 3-2: 27-25, 25-20, 20-25, 23-25, 15-12 from SMU's side. Two separately attributable official sources agree digit for digit: SMU's SidearmStats box data and UC Davis's own schedule row. The feed's linescores are REPLACED, not filled -- the only correction to do so, justified exactly because two official sources attribute every set to the opposite team from the feed. AUDITED: the per-player box rows are swapped the same way -- all 16 rows under UC Davis's team id are SMU roster players (16/16 roster-matched, 0 cross-matches) and all 17 under SMU's id are UC Davis players. box_team_swap re-attributes the rows at the derived layer; each player's own numbers are untouched and the raw log is never rewritten.

evidence.text: The SMU row (aria-label 'Box score of Women's Volleyball vs SMU on August 30, 2026'): 'Fort Collins, Colo. | L, 2-3 | (25-27, 20-25, 25-20, 25-23, 15-12)'
evidence.establishes: UC Davis lost 2-3; the same set line from UC Davis's side, digit for digit
